excerpt: Building a Sustainable Internship Program That Supports Long-Term Hiring Goals Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. One of the most common challenges newcomers and international professionals face in Canada is the so-called “No Canadian Experience” barrier. Many talented immigrants find themselves struggling to secure their first job or advance their careers because employers often prefer candidates with Canadian work experience.
